# Introduction {.unnumbered}

This workbook contains materials for a work-in-progress course on the
fundamentals of data science, computational population genomics and inference,
with a strong focus on good practices of reproducible research and programming
in R.

The general structure of the final book (expected to be developed over the
course of 2025-2026) will take the form of a series of worksheets with
exercises on varrious interlinked topics from computational population
genetics. The primary goal is for students to walk through these worksheets in
the classroom under the interactive guidance of a teacher, but each chapter is
also suitable for self-study and designed to serve as a reference during
practical research work.

The git repository containing the sources of all materials for the entire
course (text of the worksheets, coding exercises and their solutions) is
available on GitHub at
[github.com/bodkan/simgen](https://github.com/bodkan/simgen).

The primary intended audience for this material are novice researchers who have
just started (or are about to start) their careers in computational population
genomics and evolutionary genomics, primarily master students or doctoral
students in the early parts of their research journey. However, some of the
materials have also been used in training workshops of researchers who have had
a relatively extensive experience with population genomics, but who were not
entirely up-to-speed on modern practices in reproducible computational data
science or have not had the opportunity to engage with fundamental concepts in
population genomics from the ground up.

---

## Planned outline

Status of chapters:

- ✅: Chapter is finished

- 🚧: Chapter under construction
left)

- ❌: Chapter still missing

---

- ✅ **Introduction to R**
  - ✅ Basic data types and container types
  - ✅ Functions and iteration
  - ✅ Data manipulation using base R
  - ✅ Minimum background on base R visualization

- 🚧 **Reproducible computing**
  - ✅ What makes for a good project structure
  - ✅ Transforming disorganized scripts into pipelines
  - ✅ Reproducible reports and presentations with Quarto
  - 🚧 Building interfaces for command-line scripts

- ✅ **_tidyverse_**
  - ✅ Filtering, processing, and manipulation of data
  - ✅ Group-based operations and summary statistics
  - ✅ Reading and saving files
  - ✅ Visualization using _ggplot2_
  
- 🚧 **Working with spatial data**
  - 🚧 _sf_ spatial data format
  - 🚧 Plotting spatial data with _sf_ and _ggplot2_

- ✅ **Simulations with _slendr_**
  - ✅ Introduction to the R package _slendr_
  - ✅ Building demographic models
  - ✅ Tree sequences as a storage of genomic information

- 🚧 **Fundamentals of population genetics**
  - 🚧 Effective population size $N_e$
  - 🚧 Allele frequency spectrum
  - 🚧 Nucleotide diversity $\pi$, number of segregating sites, $F_{ST}$, nucleotide divergence
  - ✅ Tying it all together&mdash;grid-based inference engine of $N_e$

- 🚧 **Other useful tools for studying population histories**
  - 🚧 PCA
  - 🚧 Identity-by-descent (IBD)
  - 🚧 Ancestry tracts / chromosome painting
  - 🚧 Admixture dating

- 🚧 **Simulating natural selection**
  - ❌ Basic theory of natural selection
  - 🚧 Simple one-locus simulation
  - ❌ Selection tests and summary statistics

- 🚧 **Simulation-based inference with _demografr_**
  - 🚧 Grid-based inference ($f_4$ and $f_4$-ratio) &mdash; sourced from [_demografr_](https://bodkan.net/demografr/articles/vignette-03-grids.html)
  - 🚧 Grid-based admixture tract dating &mdash; based on a [_slendr_ tutorial](https://bodkan.net/slendr/articles/vignette-10-tracts.html)
  - 🚧 Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) &mdash; sourced from [_demografr_](https://bodkan.net/demografr/articles/vignette-03-grids.html)

- 🚧**Workhorses of applied population genetics**
  - 🚧 MDS / PCA &mdash; extending the PCA chapters [part 1](https://bodkan.net/simgen/nonspatial-pca.html) and  [part 2](https://bodkan.net/simgen/spatial-pca.html) to real-world scenarios
  - 🚧 ADMIXTOOLS - $f$-statistics, qpAdm &mdash; extending the [$f$-statistics chapter](https://bodkan.net/simgen/popgen-stats.html) to other real-world scenarios
  - ❌ ADMIXTURE / STRUCTURE &mdash; focusing on the [non-identifiability](https://github.com/bodkan/simgen/blob/main/files/slendr/images/admixture.png) problem
  - ❌ IBD
  - ❌ Selection scans and summary statistics
